overview: Lost in Austen is a four-part 2008 British television series for the ITV network, written by Guy Andrews as a fantasy adaptation of Pride and Prejudice by Jane Austen. Loosely following the novel plot, modern Amanda enters through a portal in her bathroom, to join the Bennet family and affect events disastrously.
title: Lost in Austen

overview: Californian surf culture seems to exude effortless coolness. But behind the façade lies a murky past, and a problematic present of Hollywood whitewashing, swastikas, and racism.
title: Black Surfers Matter
Chuai Diao Zha Fu Hou，Wo Zhuan Shen Cheng Le She Zheng Wang Fei
Love And Hate With You. Let It Be.

overview: A sudden encounter between a gracefully attractive but mysterious woman, Saki, and an ordinary housewife, Eriko, who has a happy family, causes Eriko's serene daily life to fall apart. Eriko's husband, Shinji becomes the target of Saki's advances and finds himself caught between her and his wife.
title: Utsukushii Rinjin

overview: With only 168 HOURS left before death claims her, Winrawi finds herself the target of a relentless, vengeful spirit whose dark presence draws closer with each passing second. A chilling voice whispers hoarsely, threatening to take her life and pushing her to the brink of despair. Desperate and alone, she encounters a woman with a cold, indifferent gaze - the only person who holds hope of escape from this haunting pursuit, but her plea is met with merciless rejection. As time slips away, Winrawi is forced to confront the shadows of her past, unraveling secrets that reveal a horrifying truth, spiraling toward a tragedy no one could have foreseen.
title: Runaway

overview: An unexpected romance that blossoms in the colorful setting of an amusement park between Lilin, a heir to a powerful family business, and Ing Ing, the diligent amusement park manager.
title: Play Park

overview: Jane is confused about whether P'Dai's feelings are just kindness or if it's something more special!? We'll have to wait and see just when Jane will realize she's being courted!
title: Like a Palette

overview: Year 2026. The life of Dima, a forty-year-old ER doctor, has gone downhill: his wife left him, his colleagues despise him, and alcohol has become his best friend. But one day, during an MRI, Dima is suddenly transported to 2002. He's an eighteen-year-old again, his mother is alive, the love of his life is still available, and the fateful meeting with his ex-wife hasn't happened. He has a chance to live his life anew and, perhaps, fix everything.
title: Жизнь заново

overview: Jane is chasing her dream of opening a Shio Pan bakery. However, opportunity never seems to knock. Finally, Jane turns to a merit-collecting application called "Lucky Points". Jane makes three wishes: a large sum of capital, a rental building at a great price, and someone who will love and stay by her side. Unfortunately, her accumulated merit points aren't enough. Jane accidentally says, "Can't I just ask for someone?", the system picks up that sentence and processes it as a new official request. The next morning, Jane wakes up to find Z, a handsome angel who is the "someone" Jane asked for. Z has been assigned to look after her for three months. However, this blessing from heaven comes with chaos. Z turns out to be a low-ranking, unskilled angel who can barely do anything.
title: Be my angel

overview: A chaotic love story between a heart-shielded introverted girl and a confident extrovert who's never afraid of love. Opposites… but perfect together. Serenity meets a storm of emotions. But in the end, will this reserved girl dare to unlock her heart for love?
title: Un-trovert

overview: Thanks to their love of chocolate, Sosuke and Hana have a chance encounter. However, due to their social anxiety, Sosuke can't touch, and Hana can't make eye contact, which brings unique challenges to their budding relationship.
title: Romantics Anonymous

overview: Documentary series in which Bram Vermeulen poignantly reveals forgotten international stories about developments that are often no more than a footnote in our daily news.
title: Frontlinie

overview: America's richest self-made woman Diane Hendricks is betting big on the town integral to her family's success. Betting on Beloit chronicles the billionaire entrepreneur and her driven, accomplished daughter Konya Hendricks Schuh's mission to revitalize Beloit, Wisconsin. The show follows Konya and her dynamic team—which includes her husband Matt (a plumbing contractor and former home builder), good friend and project manager Pete, and her realtor nephew Connor, as well as local artisans and designer friends Kristin and Mitch—as they purchase, restore and reimagine historic homes throughout Beloit's storied neighborhoods.
title: Betting on Beloit

overview: The "Nachtstreife" is back in Mainz. The fifth season accompanies Mainz police officers during their nighttime patrols in their fight against violence and crime. Every night, officers from the uniformed police, the criminal investigation department, and the highway police face new challenges: racism, violence in close social relationships, alcohol consumption, acts of violence, death, homophobia. The ARD docu-soap provides an exclusive and unadulterated insight into the demanding work of the Mainz police and shows the people behind the uniform. How do they feel when they make the city a little safer night after night? Are there police operations that are particularly stressful for them? The show features people who do their job out of conviction, who are trained professionals and want to come home healthy after a shift. The format is purely documentary. "Nachtstreife" accompanies police officers from Mainz (SWR) and Hamburg (NDR, season 4).
title: Nachtstreife

overview: What's wrong with going on a trip alone with a friend of the opposite sex? Yoon Seul who doesn't want to go home and Han Bit who doesn't want to go to the army begin their friendship trip! Wait no I mean, the friendship-destroying romance begins!
title: Because I Don't Want To Go Home

overview: Pharaohs at War explores four epic battles that changed the fate of Ancient Egypt: Megiddo, Qadesh, Raphia, and Actium. These decisive confrontations between pharaohs and their greatest rivals defined the legacy of one of history's most iconic civilisations. Each episode focuses on a high-stakes duel between a pharaoh and a formidable enemy. Through expert interviews and 3D reconstructions, the series unveils the military strategies, political motives, and human drama behind these legendary conflicts. The series follows archaeologists into the field as they uncover spectacular sites—some revealed for the first time on screen. Clue by clue, these discoveries shed light on how war reshaped Egypt's destiny.
title: Pharaohs at War

overview: Being Erica is a one-hour series that explores the life of Erica Strange, a woman who has been given a wonderful gift. Every episode, Erica goes back to relive a regret from her past, in order to come back and make a positive change in her present.
title: Being Erica

overview: On one day, the people of one South London street all receive an anonymous postcard with the simple message 'we want what you have'. Its unsettling ripples affect every corner of the community.
title: Capital

overview: After years of marriage, young artist Lu Ming and his wife Xu Xin begin to grow emotionally distant, as their once-strong bond starts to crack. In a severe car accident, Xu Xin is critically injured and falls into a prolonged coma at the hospital. At home, Lu Ming discovers a stream-of-consciousness novel written by Xu Xin. Lu Ming realizes that the novel reflects Xu Xin's unspoken emotions and her deep love for him. After reading the novel, Lu Ming regrets his past actions and rewrites its ending. Eventually, Xu Xin awakens slowly to Lu Ming's calls…
title: Restarted Love
Shi Zun Shi Ge Wei Xian Zhi Ye

overview: Documentary series where Per Wallin and Mattis Bergwall, who together make the War History podcast, take a bold approach to Sweden's own history and reveal the stories of preparedness that are rarely discussed.
title: Krigsmaskinen Sverige
Gao Men Zhu Mu Tai Xiong Meng
Leng Qing Zong Men ， Ni Hou Hui Le Ma

overview: The heiress of a merchant guild, Zhao Chunman, infiltrates the Yuchun Opera House to avenge her father's death, but tragically dies at the hands of Zhou Chi, the second-in-command of the Yi Gang. Time resets, and Zhao Chunman realizes things may not be as they seemed. Determined to uncover the truth behind her father's death and change her own fate, Chunman repeatedly faces critical choices, treading carefully with each step while also gradually winning ground in her complex relationship with Zhou Chi.
title: Spring Rewritten

overview: An immersive journey that chronicles the epic rise and fall of history's first-and-only Viking empire. Harald Bluetooth, his son Sven Forkbeard, and grandson Cnut the Great, were larger-than-life conquerors who built a sophisticated culture that transformed the image of Vikings from fearsome marauders to respectable Christian rulers. Featuring contributions by the world's leading experts, it's a riveting story of power, betrayal, and ambition that changed the course of history.
title: Vikings: The Making of an Empire

overview: Xu Beisheng vows to avenge her father by staying in the household of the warlord—the man who killed his father. Learning of a marriage alliance between the Xu and Zhou families, he meticulously plots to sabotage the union by getting close to Zhou Menghuan. However, his calculated approach crumbles as genuine feelings unexpectedly blossom. When his deception is exposed, a transformed Zhou Menghuan turns the tables, marrying into the Xu family to seek revenge. The two fall into a cycle of love and hatred amid the power struggles of wealthy clans, ultimately swept away by the tide of the war-torn era.
title: Dangerous Love

overview: The entire fox clan was exterminated by Crown Prince Xiling Xuan of Xiling Kingdom. The fox clan's saintess, Tushan Yue, managed to preserve a fragment of her soul and pursued Xiling Xuan to the royal palace of Xiling Kingdom for revenge. Tushan Yue's remaining soul attaches to the body of the late Empress Jiang Xin'er. As her revenge plan unfolds, Tushan Yue uncovers a shocking truth.
title: My Foxfoe Queen

overview: Heiress Dongfang Xi, for the sake of love, hides her identity and works to support the scoundrel Ye Yunzhou, only to be betrayed by him. Upon awakening, she realizes she is the villainous supporting female in a novel. She makes a bet with a system to change her fate and ultimately exposes Ye Yunzhou's true nature at the return banquet. When Ye Yunzhou entangles her again, she discovers that her secret admirer, Dongfang Yan, is actually the system incarnate, but deliberately loses the bet before a turning point in her destiny, revealing the love he had hidden for years.
title: Princess Revenge

overview: Murders, drug dealers, bank robbers or jail escapees. The stories are different, but the motive is always the same: to stay out of prison. See what pushed these fugitives to their crimes, how they changed their identities, evaded the law and - almost - got away with it.
title: I (Almost) Got Away with It

overview: Game show hosted by Les Dawson in which two team captains have 30 seconds to make Fast Friends.
title: Fast Friends

overview: Babatunde Aléshé presents funny videos from the internet.
title: Stupid Central

overview: Six decades of suffering for the victims' families and a case that shook the nation. Revelations and newly uncovered evidence as experts pursue answers and, ultimately, justice.
title: The Moors Murders: A Search for Justice

overview: Where broken beauty is reborn. How legendary art restorer Koji Mayuyama is preserving ancient treasures, one divine touch at a time.
title: Japan's Master of Restoration

overview: Who am I? Charlie feels like neither a woman nor a man. But then what is Charlie? The coming-of-age series Becoming Charlie follows Charlie on a quest for identity.
title: Becoming Charlie

overview: Instructor Jiang Zhen from the "Gale Training Camp" goes undercover in the Amethyst Group to investigate a fatal accident caused by a self-driving car, following the death of his younger sister Xiaotong. During the mission, he crosses paths with his former partner and now sworn enemy Bai Fan. Despite the initial suspicion, the two eventually join forces to uncover the truth behind the car accident years ago. They also discover evidence of the Amethyst Group's crimes involving brain-computer interface technology. Later, together with Nong Qianya, who also suffered persecution at the hands of the Nong family, they destroy the conspiracy of Amethyst Group's chairman, Nong Cangqin, in one go.
title: Higher

overview: This series centers on the theme of creating "miracles," spotlighting Shenzhen's remarkable achievements over the 45 years of reform and opening-up as well as its vision for the future. Through artistic storytelling, it showcases the city's unique spirit and youthful vitality.
title: The Miracles
Hua Jian Jiu Ren Jian Yue

overview: In the Republic of China era, Ye Nanzhao suffers betrayal by her former husband and the tragic loss of her daughter. On her way to report to the authorities, she is abducted and forced to assume the identity of a dead woman, becoming the second concubine of the Lu household. By a twist of fate, her treacherous ex-husband turns out to be the Lu family's new son-in-law. To make matters worse, the woman she's impersonating has left behind an absolute mess.
title: Be Not Meant to Be

overview: What chance have you got when your dad's a cop, your mum's a frighteningly understanding parent, your brother wets the bed, your best friend's a heavy metal devotee and then you fall in love at 12 and three quarters years old? It can only mean trouble, worry, mega-embarrassment and some wild, wild times. Lockie Leonard, hot surf-rat, and his family have just moved to the most remote town on earth, Angelus. For Lockie this is a total life disaster: no friends, new school and a house that is truly in danger of disappearing into a swamp… but then Lockie spots the one thing that makes it all okay, this weird little town has the best surf he has ever seen. Through the eyes of Lockie Leonard we view the truly mixed-up, yet very normal life of Lockie, his family and friends.
title: Lockie Leonard

overview: It tells the story of Yang Xiaofang and Qi Xiaowei from the same village, who become pregnant before marriage. The Yang family rushes back to the village to help Xiaofang plan her next steps. The Qi and Yang families hold different attitudes, unexpectedly stirring up a "marital storm." After negotiations between the two families break down, Xiaofang goes on blind dates while pregnant, only to become the center of attention in the entire village, sparking a series of laugh-out-loud incidents.
title: Xiao Fang

overview: The tranquility of Luzhou City is shattered by a series of murders disguised as "punishing the wicked and promoting the good." The public security authorities have formed the "909 Task Force" to investigate the case. After going through numerous difficulties, the task force gradually unveils the shocking truth behind the "Erinyes" murder and revenge plan.
title: Serial Homicide

overview: Wang Heng, a frustrated young man, accidentally travels back to the Western Han Dynasty. There, he encounters De Jiu, a female swordsman who strongly resembles his ex-girlfriend, and forms a deep friendship with Liu He, an outgoing man. Determined to team up and challenge history, the trio tries to rewrite Liu He's fate—he was once a short-lived emperor who only reigned for 27 days. Together, they embark on a bold, cross-temporal adventure to defy destiny...
title: Voyage to Haihun

overview: Louis Constantin, nicknamed "Chameleon," is a retired detective from the PJ. He keeps himself busy by conducting investigations on behalf of the CIA (insurance company), with the help of his family: his wife Charlotte (the energetic Dany Carrel), his daughter Isabelle (the bubbly Sabine Paturel), and his son Alex! Between The Pink Panther and Inspector Gadget, everyone has their own method for flushing out imposters...
title: Les Enquêtes Caméléon

overview: 2013. Searching for her missing daughter, Captain Gabrielle Moscato falls asleep in a hotel room only to wake up… in 2025, with no memory of the intervening twelve years. Atypical psychogenic amnesia has erased her memory but hasn't altered her instincts as a cop, nor her instincts as a mother. How far will she go to save her daughter? Or rather, how far has it already gone?
title: Il était deux fois

overview: One morning, after woke up, Chen Jing'an and Zhu Niannian found their souls were swapped. Jing'an becomes the "heiress of a wealthy family," while Niannian turns into the "younger sister" of her secret crush. But as they team up with Chen Changning, who maybe uncover the truth, to investigate the reason of the drama, more chaos and obstacles arise. The situation also becomes more and more unpredictable.
title: Flower Sea

overview: Wow The World takes viewers on a global journey with its guests, uncovering local cultures and cuisines while promoting environmental and charitable values. The show features immersive challenges such as ingredient foraging, cooking competitions, and cultural exploration. It offers a vibrant glimpse into the unique charm of different regions and the fusion of diverse cultures.
title: Wow the World

overview: Win loses both his best friend Nut and their shared music dream. One day, he's taken back to age 17 and reunites with Nut. As they form a band and chase their dream, changing the past risks losing Nut again. Can Win make it right this time?
title: Rearrange

overview: At the heart of the action is the Mobile Unit, an elite tactical team within Rongcheng's Criminal Investigation Division. Crime scenes are their domain, for example, a meticulously staged celebrity suicide, a masterfully planned heist, a perfectly concealed drug den, a cop ambush laced with traps, and so on. Criminals may set elaborate decoys, but they are no match for the detectives' sharp eyes.
title: Police Tactical Unit

overview: Welcome to the unconventional family life of KISS front man Gene Simmons. Simmons and actress Shannon Tweed have been happily unmarried for twenty years and have two children, Nick and Sophie. Gene Simmons: Family Jewels reveals a side of Gene that has remained hidden until now. See the softer side of this metal manic as he balances his rock star life with his role as a dad.
title: Gene Simmons: Family Jewels
Miss Dong Spends Valentine's Day Every Day

overview: In the 1970s and 1980s, the story follows a group of young performers in a military arts troupe as they chase their dreams on stage. Amid social change, reform, love and difficult life choices, they grow into outstanding dancers and dedicate their youth to the army and their country.
title: Red Dance Shoes

overview: When young coroner Xu Linlang is swept into the underworld by a bloody massacre, she joins forces with Lu Jiu and Sima Kong. This unlikely trio navigates a labyrinth of power, where factions like Wuxiang City weave deadly schemes, uncovering truths while forging bonds in the shadowy underworld.
title: The Formless City

overview: Both of the Jiang family's daughters are reborn. Jiang Xueying, the eldest daughter of the Jiang family, swaps her marriage with her younger sister Jiang Yu'er. As the prince's wife, Jiang Xueying battles cunning rivals in the household, including Jiang Yu'er. She reforms her reckless husband and joins forces with him to expose a sinister conspiracy.
title: Threads of Destiny

overview: Grade 12 in high school, a season between spring and summer that will never come again. It's hot and sweaty and the sound of summer bugs fills the air. Do Wan feels anxious as he senses that his time with Jae Yul is running out.
title: The Nameless Season

overview: The Hospital, a new satirical sketch comedy series that offers a behind-the-scenes look at what happens when you mix improv comedy with ‘total medical negligence.
title: The Hospital

overview: A Current Affair, Australia's most-watched daily current affairs program, has launched a new weekly podcast, That's ACA, taking listeners and viewers behind the scenes of the show's most talked-about stories. Hosted by seasoned reporters Steve Marshall and Lizzie Pearl, That's ACA offers a candid look into the world of television reporting. Each week, the hosts dissect the biggest stories, share their personal experiences on the road and talk to the program's stable of reporters about the weird and wonderful assignments that capture the nation's attention.
title: That's ACA

overview: Step inside the TheatreDome for an exhilarating battle of wits and theatrical fun, premiering weekdays from August 4 at 7.30am on 9Go! and 9Now. TheatreDome is an electrifying new series bringing a fresh wave of creativity and fun to children's television. Breaking new ground, TheatreDome reworks the traditional improv format to resonate with young Aussies, standing out as Australia's first improvisational shows for children. Aspiring drama students step inside the TheatreDome for a series of hilarious improv sketch battles. Guided by professional mentors known as "The Oracles", two teams, The Fates and The Muses, go head-to-head within the mysterious TheatreDome, under the watchful eye of The Great Overseer. The ultimate goal? To be crowned the undisputed champion of the TheatreDome!
title: TheatreDome

overview: The Kalachevs save on everything, and their father, school teacher Rostik, keeps track of expenses in a notebook and dreams of a grant. The family is not discouraged, participating in relay races, lotteries and competitions where they can win a useful prize. Everything changes when Rostik gets a winning ticket for 1,000,000,000 rubles. It would seem that now the Kalachevs have nothing to worry about, because they are provided for for life. But with the appearance of big money, big problems appear...
title: Миллиард проблем

overview: Yin Zheng seeks revenge for her mother and meets Prince Wen Ze under unexpected circumstances. As they search for the truth, they overcome misunderstandings and develop trust and love for each other.
title: Half Awake in a Fleeting Dream

overview: Join brothers Aaron and Ben, and their mate Shanon as we take viewers head-first into one of Sydney's most renowned pawn retailer chains "Happy Hockers" on Pawn Stars Australia. If it can be bought or sold the "Happy Hockers" have seen it and probably made an offer. From a treasured tile from the roof of the Sydney Opera House, to a prosthetic leg, and even a Laughing Clown amusement park game from Luna Park, you never know what will be brought through the doors and wind up on an episode of Pawn Stars Australia. With four shops, and 22 years behind the counter, they're always ready to buy, sell or pawn anything. If there's money to be made, there's always a deal to be done!
title: Pawn Stars Australia

overview: Saburo works at a medical office on The Izu Islands, which has seen its population dwindle over the years. Even though Saburo doesn't have a medical license, he performs operations under the instructions of Dr. Muraki. Because of his gifted dexterity and sincerity, people call him the Young Doctor. Saburo becomes conflicted over his position, but he convinces himself that what he is doing is helping people. Saburo is also loved by nurse Akiko Suzuki and Akiko Tasaka, who is the daughter of the director of a general hospital in Tokyo.
title: Kumo no Kaidan

overview: A comedy-drama that depicts three crooks extorting large sums of money from people who are stained with desire with grand and unusual plans on the stage of the colorful world of real estate and finance.
title: Confidence Man

overview: The main character Tonya is 16 years old, she is an excellent student, is engaged in dancing and is crazy about the main handsome boy of the school, Semyon. To please him, Tonya tries to appear older and lies that she has been dating guys for a long time. But for Semyon, a date with Tonya is just entertainment, and for Tony it's the first time. In a couple of weeks, she finds out that she is pregnant. The girl cannot admit to anyone what happened and finds herself all alone in front of the most difficult choice. Tony's classmate Mitya suddenly becomes the only one who lends a shoulder. Under the yoke of condemnation from parents and the public, the heroine will have to go through a difficult path.
title: 16 лет и 9 месяцев

overview: «Kto kuda» is not just a travel show, it is a real travel game, where the hosts become players. Here they do not rely on fate and do not toss coins: Leo and Angelica choose where they will go themselves and compete for a place in a luxury hotel. For one day, the hosts go to different parts of Russia to get to know the city and its color better with the help of specially prepared tasks for each other. Whoever passes the tests faster gets the right to spend the night in the most luxurious hotel. The loser will spend the night in an ordinary cheap hostel.
title: Кто куда

overview: Oddities is a half-hour documentary/reality television program which follows the operation of an East Village, Manhattan shop which trades in antiques and other rarities.
title: Oddities

overview: A viral joke about storming a secretive US Air Force base sparks a meme-fueled media frenzy and puts the military on alert in this bizarre true story.
title: Trainwreck: Storm Area 51

overview: Featuring exclusive access, riveting stories, surprising revelations, and jaw-dropping hammer prices, Secret Life of the Auction House goes behind the scenes at one of Britain's busiest auction houses to capture all the drama, passion, and charisma as antiques specialist Charles Hanson and a small army of experts examine, appraise, strategize, and sell to the highest bidder—all while making historic discoveries and keeping an eye out for fakes. Every treasure has a unique story to tell. And with hundreds of thousands of objects coming through the door every year, Charles and the team bring long-forgotten relics, cherished heirlooms, attic discoveries, and metal detector finds to life
title: Secret Life of the Auction House

overview: Kostya, the ambulance driver, is used to living one day at a time. Mired in debt and loans, he couldn't think of anything better than to take the first bus he saw and get away from Moscow and his problems. So he finds himself in a southern village, where he is mistaken for the long-awaited doctor Christopher Sergeevich. The locals welcome Kostya with all cordiality and even provide him with housing. It seems that the guy had the perfect chance to quickly resolve the issue of money and return to Moscow. But pretending to be an experienced healer without understanding anything about medicine is not an easy task, so Kostya will have to somehow get out of it.
title: Знахарь
Meet You and Turn Bad Luck Into Good

overview: The so-called useless live-in son-in-law is actually the eldest grandson of a billionaire family. To survive, he hides his identity and marries into another household as a nobody. But beneath that humble facade, he sweeps through high society, building power while hunting the mastermind behind his parents' murder. Along the way, Ye Chen gathers loyal allies and forms deep bonds with trusted confidantes. As the truth about his parents' deaths comes to light, a new identity crisis emerges, threatening everything he's fought for. With danger closing in from all sides, how will Ye Chen fight back this time?
title: The Hidden Heir Ye Chen

overview: A bromance story between Yun Je, a timid part-timer who is afraid of guns and swords and kills people in outrageous ways, and Jin Hyeok, a former superstar baseball player who has been saving Yun Je's targets for some time.
title: The Killer Next Door

overview: Four close friends' seemingly perfect lives unravel after one vanishes on a hunting trip. Nearly 20 years later, the truth emerges with devastating consequences.
title: Mr. & Mrs. Murder

overview: Cash in the Attic is a UK television show on the BBC. The show, made by Leopard Films, premiered in 2002. The programme's tagline is "The show that helps you find hidden treasures in your home, and then sells them for you at auction". In the show, the presenter visits a family's house to find out what they need to raise money for. They then explore the house and its surroundings, finding antiques and valuing them, with the help of experts. The family then goes to auction with the aim of making their financial target. The auction never takes place on the same day as the rummage; often it can take place several weeks later.
title: Cash in the Attic

overview: Perf is an ensemble multi-camera comedy that reflects Andrea Savage's aspirational, edgy real life-based voice and her ability to tap into the humor of being an adult.
title: Perf

overview: Pitch Perfect: K-Pop Idols follows a struggling singer-songwriter whose life completely turns upside down when she finds herself auditioning to be a part of the first all-American K-pop group.
title: Pitch Perfect: K-Pop Idols

overview: Yeon Woo grew up happy in a loving family. One day, her father had died mysteriously, and her mother remarried a man who was 10 years younger than her. Misfortunes never come singly. Her mother died of Wilson's disease and her step-father ran away with money. Min Ho, an old friend of hers, is always there to comforther. Min Ho decided to be a policeman to catch a murderer who killed Yeon Woo's father. Eun Sup came back to Korea with the sole purpose of stopping his lover Soo Ah from getting married, but Soo Ah gave him an outright denial. To make matter wose, his father sent people over to his hotel to catch him. He ran away from the hotel and he accidentally fell into the subway track and became unconscious. Yeon Woo saw the whole scene in the platform and saved his life. Eun Sup asked her if he could stay in her place temporarily since he had no place to go. So Yeon Woo, Min Ho and Eun Sup all started living in a same house.
title: Rays of Sunshine

overview: Code Geass: Soubou no Oz Picture Drama following the lives of two characters from opposite sides of the barricades: Orpheus Zevon—young theorist from KMF searching for the killer of his mistress and Oldrin Zevon—protiteristické member unit of the British Empire "Glindyni knights." Drama quite obviously inspired by the classic story of The Wizard of Oz. This is OVA series.
title: Code Geass: Soubou no Oz Picture Drama

overview: Reggie and Ronnie Kray built a feared yet admired criminal empire in East London. Never-before-heard tapes reveal their bond, ambition, and downfall.
title: KRAYS: London's Gangsters

overview: This is the story of the creation of the Nazi War Machine, tracing their origins from street thugs battling in the German streets after The Great War. We show the growth of the Panzer Corps, the mighty Luftwaffe and the feared SS. This is the most comprehensive look at the military force that took Europe by a storm of blood and steel.
title: Military Machines: Nazi Germany in WWII

overview: A drama about a young top actress named Im Se Ra, who gets into an accident on the day she is to receive her Best Actress award, and comes back to work after a 25-year career gap.
title: My Troublesome Star

overview: A four-part docuseries investigating the 1995 death of Argentine president Carlos Menem's son -- and a mother's decades-long quest for justice.
title: Menem Junior, la Muerte del Hijo del Presidente

overview: The five-part docuseries tells the authentic tale of a club accustomed to sporting heartbreak, who are rebuilt to win, with American football legend Tom Brady laying out their new mission statement: "We're trying to make this a world-class team." Built in Birmingham: Brady & the Blues follows that journey, as a new ownership group suffer relegation and multiple managerial changes en route to a record-breaking season, which delivered automatic promotion to the EFL Sky Bet Championship.
title: Built in Birmingham: Brady & the Blues

overview: Dancing on Ice is a reality series in which celebrities and their professional partners figure skate in front of a panel of judges. Each week the celebrities and their partners perform a live ice dance routine. The judges judge each performance and give a score, depending on the performance. These total scores then create a leaderboard which combines with the public vote in order to determine the two lowest placed couples. As this is the case, the pair with the lowest score from the judges can avoid being in the bottom two if the public vote for them. Once the scores and votes are combined to form the final leaderboard for that week's show, the two/three couples at the bottom compete in a final showdown known as the "Skate Off", where they perform their routine again. Once the couples have performed their routines for the judging panel, the judges decide on who deserves to stay and cast their votes, based on their second performance. The couple with the most votes from the judges receives a place in the following week's show, while the couple with the fewest votes leaves the competition.
title: Dancing on Ice

overview: From Nashville to New Orleans, comedian Griff Rhys Jones goes on an epic road trip across the US Deep South, exploring America's secret heart and busting the clichés with his trademark wit and warmth.
title: Griff's Great American South

overview: Their names still echo down the ages: The Great Pyramid at Giza. The Hanging Gardens of Babylon. The Temple of Artemis. The statue of Zeus at Olympia. The mausoleum of Halikarnassos. The Colossus at Rhodes. The Lighthouse of Alexandria. The Seven Wonders of the World were staggeringly audacious impositions on our planet. They were also brilliant adventures of the mind, test cases for the reaches of human imagination. Now only the great pyramid remains fully standing, yet the scale and majesty of these seven wonders still enthral us today. In a thrilling, colourful narrative enriched with the latest archaeological discoveries, historian Bettany Hughes walks through the landscapes of both ancient and modern time. This is a journey whose purpose is to ask why we wonder, why we create, why we choose to remember the wonder of others. She explores traces of the Wonders themselves, and the traces they have left in history. A magisterial work of historical storytelling, The Seven Wonders of the Ancient World reinforces the exciting and nourishing notion that humans can make the impossible happen.
title: Seven Wonders of the Ancient World with Bettany Hughes

overview: In her past life, Xie Minglan was bestowed the title of a first-rank noble lady, basking in glory and prestige. Meanwhile, her sister Xie Molan became a young widow, confined to a lonely Buddhist retreat. Consumed by jealousy, Xie Molan killed Xie Minglan, only to find herself reborn with her sister on the day when they were both to be wed. This time, Xie Molan desperately schemes to marry Mr. Pei, the down-and-out heir, believing this will swap their fates. Little does she know that she has chosen a path of no return.
title: Bride Swap
